notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, hey Super Bullet Breakers!

Some lovely news - we have a new patch live today.

The latest patch includes:
-	Various bug fixes
-	Improvements to Spanish localisation
-	Finally, the game has received some additional Steam Deck support! 

May your day be filled with beautiful “Bullets” and kawaii combat! Happy Gaming!! 

スーパーバレットブレイクのファンの皆様！

本日、新しいパッチをリリースいたしました。

最新のパッチには、以下が含まれています。
・バグ修正
・スペイン語翻訳の改善
・追加のSteam Deckのサポート

素敵な”バレット”と愛すべきバトルに溢れた１日をお過ごしください！Happy Gaming!!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2]👾 SURPRISE! 👾 [/h2]

We are excited to finally share that [i]Super Bullet Break[/i] will be released on[b] 12 August 2022[/b]!
You read that right, that's [b]THIS YEAR[/b] and it's less than 3 months away! 

We are so excited for you to see everything that [i]Super Bullet Break[/i] has to offer and can't wait for you to get your hands on it. 
But ... just in case you simply cannot wait any longer, we've got some good news for you:

[b]The Super Bullet Break demo will be available up until launch for you to play! 🥳 [/b]

So have fun, enjoy the demo  and let the countdown begin! [i]Super Bullet Break[/i] and its over 160 Bullets are coming soon!

[b]
Check out the trailer here: [/b]
[previewyoutube=3nUa-Vo4ZfI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Super Bullet Break: Key Features and Items
notes.content:
[h3]Happy Monday, Super Bullet Breakers,[/h3]

long time no see! We hope you've enjoyed getting a first look at [i]Super Bullet Break[/i] during Steam's Going Rogue event! 
Today, it's time to learn some more about [i]Super Bullet Break'[/i]s key features and items. Always remember, getting to know all about the key mechanics of a game, is the first step in becoming a true champion.

So, let's dive right in!

[h3][u]Key Features
[/u][/h3]

First, and most importantly, there's no[i] Super Bullet Break[/i] without its [b]Bullets[/b] and there are over 160 of them - plenty to choose from! They're each beneficial in their own way and their data will not only show their Name but also their Rarity, Cost, Ability, Attack Power, and Attack Range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/9e29cd0000e101a86e04575459b9c8ff8c10d98c.gif[/img]

Each Bullet is attached to a [b]Cartridge[/b] indicating its Name, Value, Ability, and Activity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/8c85e6854b2a530bdf520c2ab5dcc343007fbd5d.png[/img]

For now, that's all the information necessary to navigate your Bullets and the Cartridges attached to them, so let's talk game features now. 

[i]Super Bullet Break[/i] is much more than just its battle mechanics (which we'll teach you about in time) but there's much more to explore.

How about you check out the [b]Messages [/b]on your character's phone? Here you'll find [b]Missions [/b]you'll need to progress, [b]Game News [/b]which will update you on what's going on in the Game World, and [b]Conversations [/b]which are fun and casual chatter between the girls!

The [b]Field Guide[/b] is your place to check your progress, here you'll find the Bullets and Cartridges you have collected along the way, the story so far, as well as your gameplay records! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/a897b0447004ceb78f74021786504fc56ada4705.png[/img]

But that's not all, once you're getting started with the actual game there's much more to discover. We've talked about Bullets before but did you know you can get an extra Bullet by rolling up to 3 times for a [b]Supporting Bullet[/b] at the beginning of each mission? 

Another way to collect more Bullets is through[b] Scouting Tickets[/b] which you can get a hold of a number of different ways by either being given them at Event Blocks, buying them, or winning them at Treasure Blocks. No matter how you get them, exchange them at the shop for a Bullet of your choice by selecting two data traits. 

[u][h3]Items [/h3][/u]

Check your backpack to see, use, or discard a maximum of six items. They'll be useful for you in a number of different ways from restoring HP to giving you advantages over enemies. 
There's plenty of items to win and buy such as
[list]
[*] [b]Potions [/b]- They restore HP (depending on which type of Potion you acquire, they'll restore up to 30 HP)
[*] [b]Prophecy [/b]- This item inflicts a countdown on random foes but leaves bosses unaffected
[*] [b]Forbidden Fruit[/b] - They inflict confusion on all foes
[*] [b]Feeble Foes[/b] - This item, on the other hand, inflicts feeble on all foes 
[*] [b]Buggo Amber[/b] - An item that dispels all enemies 
[/list]
... and soooo many more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/145a23cd8192a1802688741d20105e9376e5d14d.png[/img]

These are just a few of [i]Super Bullet Break[/i]'s amazing and fun features, but we just don't want to spoil the surprise. 

[b]Keep your eyes out for more exciting announcements and content coming your way. [/b]

notes.title: Super Bullet Break: Character Introductions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/104207f2880e73f7b776d29ef067dffdb9312d5d.png[/img]

Welcome back everyone,

It’s been about two weeks since we’ve announced [i]Super Bullet Break[/i] is coming to Steam and thought it was about time you got to know some of the characters you’ll encounter when it launches this year! 

[i]Super Bullet Break[/i] is filled with sooo many bold, colourful, and fun characters from playable characters, collectable Bullets, and those who support you along the way as you revive the world of online gaming! Here are some of our most beloved characters and Bullets … but don’t you worry, there won’t be too many, you’ll meet the others soon enough 😉 

[h1]Akari [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/c75de230a1b81280a4658e1560936d5c729117cd.gif[/img]

Hey, it’s you! You got that right, you’ll play Akari, a quirky redhead who is really just a big bundle of energy. While eager to save the games she loves from total destruction, she is just as quick to jump to actions and conclusions (much to the annoyance of Nayuta and Blackcat) … this might explain her somewhat aggressive play style. 

[h1]Blackcat & Nayuta [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/eb8d8fb20dd9a7d578782e73f094c2848a8905ca.png[/img]

Blackcat is … you guessed it, quite literally a black cat, and who doesn’t love a sassy, speaking furry sidekick? Your loyal companion will be by your side all the way as you battle your way through the maps of[i] Super Bullet Break[/i] and is eager to help you solve their mysteries, even if you seem to annoy your furry friend from time to time. Oh, and then there’s Nayuta, another faithful companion and friend of yours. 

[h1]Ruy Lopez
[/h1]

“A young girl who drew a sword from a stone and became the Hero tasked with saving the world” – this is how[i] Super Bullet Break [/i]describes one of its heroes Ruy Lopez. This heroic Monochrome Bullet, has a heart of gold as well as a courageous one. There’s no one more eager to stand up against the evil Black Army … a little odd then, that when you meet her, she wants to quit this ‘hero nonsense’ …

[h1]King Ducholi [/h1]

Every hero needs a sworn enemy, right? Better known as the Black King, King Ducholi is “almighty demon with a cocky and selfish personality” and she’s about to make your efforts to beat Monochrome Tactics reeeeaally heard. She might surprise you … for a demon, she is weirdly charismatic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227446/0ee9967592e42ee2935d5f58a16e2d5be0fd51f9.png[/img]
[b]
Got you excited to play? Just you wait until you meet the remaining over 160 Bullets! 
We can't wait to hear who your favourite is going to be![/b]
